Google AI Leadership Restructured Amid Key Departures

Google has restructured its AI leadership, with Demis Hassabis stepping down as CEO of DeepMind to become chief scientist. Several key engineers, including Jeff Dean, Google's 30th employee and chief scientist, have left the company to start a new AI venture. The departures follow those of two other prominent researchers to rival AI firms. Alphabet has not provided specific reasons for the timing of these changes.
